Technical Specifications

Material High-Quality Polypropylene (PP++)
Thread Connection 3/4" BSP (Standard Pipe Thread)
Hose Length 18" Inches (~ 450 mm)
Nozzle Options Round Nozzle & Flat Nozzle
Bending Angle 360° Fully Flexible Bending Radius (length size 450mm and above)

Product Description

Engineered from premium Acetal Copolymer (PP++), KRC® plastic coolant hoses offer exceptional chemical resistance to cutting oils, solvents, and emulsions. The modular segment design holds its exact position under fluid pressure with zero springback.

  • Targeted coolant placement reduces thermal wear.
  • Non-conductive properties are ideal for EDM machines.
